Then, M started talking about someone she knows and the fertility struggles that she’s having, saying things about her “geriatric eggs” and how risky it all is at her age. Then, M grew wistful about how it was probably too late for her to have babies. It was my only chance to catch up with my friend and I wanted to keep the mood light, but the evening was ruined.
